name: legal-bge-in
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512 = the BERT 512-token encoder limit). bge's documented max query length is 512 tokens.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. MultipleNegativesRankingLoss fine-tune of BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (768-dim, 109M) for retrieval over Indian case law (Supreme Court of India + Delhi High Court). Identical tensor set to the base - this is a weight fine-tune, not an architecture change. Trained on ~9,585 (question, passage) pairs built without human labelling (AI-generated ISSUES: headnotes plus synthetic queries), 2 epochs, batch 32, lr 2e-5, max_seq_length 384, one RTX 5060 Ti. Eval discipline is unusually good for this queue: 447 held-out questions against a fixed candidate pool, set frozen before training, leakage checked, every number an A/B on the identical pool. Read the ceiling: the card itself says absolute scores are on a reduced pool and the DELTA is the trustworthy signal, so treat +7.2 pts Recall@10 as the claim, not 0.7897 as a general retrieval score. Queries are AI-generated legal-issue questions - a proxy for lawyer queries, not user logs. MIT, repo created 2026-07-12. Confidence 0.55.
